name: milk pot
caption: A milk pot with a small cavity, one long handle and a pouring rim. Continuous walls enclose a cavity; two handles join opposite wall sides. Circular walls keep an even thickness with a sealed base and a thick rim. Overall width is 1.20 times depth; height is 0.55 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous blue, dark brown, tan color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
